comments: Input facts: intersection-cross-traffic; both partners are cars; ego is the initiator and agent1 the responder; both planned intersection paths cross. Chosen assumptions: four-way junction, lateral approaches, 12-24 m initial approach clearance, nonzero initial speeds equal to trajectory target speeds (m/s), and ego reaching the crossing 0.1-0.45 s before agent1 under constant-speed estimates. The crossing opportunity is intentional; no collision is required. Ego proceeds straight across the left-turn path of agent1 approaching from the right. Agent1 continues its committed left turn under trajectory control without an added evasive brake.
